data.Any Other Information: The students are given a task of submitting case study related to Air pollution that are recently happened in our india. also  present through charts
The students undergone online certification courses like NPTEl and Course era to learn the content beyond the syllabus through online platform to explore the self learning  process.
The students are given a task to collect the users in any one of the department and design the septic tank for the particular department

the students were given a task of  explore the important dams in various places across the world to know the techniques involved in the construction and storage of water. Also advised them to present and submit a report.

the students are given a task to visit the nearest petrol bunk to view and explore the various properties of fluids during the weekend and asked to submit the report so that they can learn the real time change of property of the fluid
The students are taken  for field visit to DAM to know the structures of dam and explore the water resources and irrigatio practices
